questions.question: Which App Router file renders the /reports page?
questions.explanation: A page file supplies the route's public UI.

questions.question: Which directory name makes the order ID dynamic in app/orders/.../page.tsx?
questions.explanation: Square brackets declare a dynamic route segment.

questions.question: A route page needs a server-only credential to query the database. Where should that query run?

options.a: Inside a click handler in the browser
options.b: In a module referenced by a public script tag
options.c: In a Client Component with the credential passed as a prop
options.d: In server-side code used by the Server Component

questions.explanation: Server-side code can access the credential without shipping it to the browser.

questions.question: A module is the entry point of an interactive counter imported into a Server Component. Which directive belongs at the top?
questions.explanation: use client marks a module as a client entry point.

questions.question: Which App Router files can provide a loading UI and a segment error boundary respectively? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: loading provides a loading fallback, and error provides the segment error boundary UI.

questions.question: An App Router endpoint needs to handle GET /api/ping. Where should the GET export go?
questions.explanation: A route.ts file defines HTTP method handlers at its segment path.

questions.question: Which file supplies shared UI around all pages inside the dashboard segment?
questions.explanation: A segment layout renders shared UI around its children.

questions.question: Which component is the usual choice for an internal link that participates in Next.js client-side navigation?
questions.explanation: Link integrates internal anchors with Next.js routing.

questions.question: What URL corresponds to app/(shop)/cart/page.tsx?
questions.explanation: A route group organizes files without adding a URL segment.

questions.question: Which tasks belong on the server when an app processes orders? Select all that apply.

options.c: Verify permission before writing the order
options.d: Read window.matchMedia to change a local UI animation

questions.explanation: Credentials and authoritative write authorization belong on the server.

questions.question: A page requested by slug has no corresponding record. Which helper can show the route's not-found UI?
questions.explanation: notFound interrupts rendering and selects the not-found UI.

questions.question: Which export computes route metadata from loaded data?
questions.explanation: generateMetadata produces metadata dynamically for a segment.

questions.question: Which App Router client Hook reads the current URL's query parameters?
questions.explanation: useSearchParams exposes read-only query parameter access in client code.

questions.question: Which export can provide parameters to prerender dynamic routes at build time?
questions.explanation: generateStaticParams returns parameter values for the dynamic segments.

questions.question: Which values can cross a Server Component to Client Component boundary as ordinary props? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: React can serialize strings and arrays of numbers. Ordinary closures and live connection objects are not serializable props.

questions.question: Which name keeps a private key outside Next.js's public environment variable convention?
questions.explanation: The NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix is for values that may be exposed to client bundles.

questions.question: Which Next.js component can provide image optimization and reserve space using image dimensions?
questions.explanation: Image can optimize image delivery and use dimensions to reserve layout space.

questions.question: A form calls a Server Action to update an order. Where must the action verify the caller's authority?

options.a: In the server-side action before writing

questions.explanation: The code performing the protected write must verify authorization server-side.

questions.question: Which server API invalidates cached data associated with a particular page or layout path?
questions.explanation: revalidatePath marks the supplied path for revalidation.

questions.question: Which responsibilities fit an App Router Route Handler? Select all that apply.

options.b: Act as a React layout for its children

questions.explanation: Route Handlers implement HTTP endpoints and can read request bodies and return JSON.
